title: Adai
description: A coarse rice and four-dal batter with red chillies, for crispy protein-rich pancakes.
ingredients: ½ cup Split chana dal (Kadala paruppu)
½ cup Toor dal (split pigeon peas)
½ cup Moong dal (split yellow mung beans)
½ cup Urad dal (split skinless black gram)

steps.title: Soak grains
steps.text: Wash and soak the rice, chana dal, toor dal, moong dal, urad dal and dried red chillies in water for 12 hours.

steps.title: Grind
steps.text: In a mixer or grinder, grind the soaked rice, dal and chilli mixture along with the asafoetida and salt.

steps.title: Texture
steps.text: Make sure the batter is ground to a coarse consistency (not smooth). Use it to make crispy adai pancakes.
